title: Quarkus Native Image Isn't Working on Lambda
body:
### Describe the bug

When I try to deploy a native image lambda while following this tutorial I keep getting this error.  https://quarkus.io/guides/amazon-lambda-http 

```
RequestId: 205eadec-1ee1-499d-869e-0d048cd3ce15 Error: fork/exec /var/task/bootstrap: exec format error
Runtime.InvalidEntrypoint
```
Here are my java version 
![quarkus-lambda-rest-orig — konstantin@TEAL-C02F44B2MD6P — -zsh — 156×33 2021-08-19 at 3 20 56 PM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31769496/130131178-e667369d-c939-471f-8e22-3523b2c44b53.jpg)


I've run commands 

``` 
mvn clean install -D native
mvn clean install -Dnative -Dnative-image.docker-build=true
```

and then try 

```
sam local start-api --template target/sam.native.yaml 
sam deploy -t target/sam.native.yaml -g 
```
I've tried every mvn command with both sam commands and I am always getting this error. I've also tried to change the 
` <quarkus.package.type>native</quarkus.package.type>`  to uber-jar. Nothing works. I've successfully tested this tutorial with the jvm, but the native binary always has this issue. I would love some help. Thank you!





### Expected behavior

This is what I expect the server to return 
hello jaxrs

### Actual behavior

I get this on the screen 
```
{"message": "Internal server error"}
```
and this error logged in aws
```
RequestId: 205eadec-1ee1-499d-869e-0d048cd3ce15 Error: fork/exec /var/task/bootstrap: exec format error
Runtime.InvalidEntrypoint
```

### How to Reproduce?

Follow this tutorial https://quarkus.io/guides/amazon-lambda-http 
1. mvn clean install -Dnative 
2. sam local start-api --template target/sam.native.yaml
3 sam deploy -t target/sam.native.yaml -g
